name: CR&R Environmental Services
notes: Moved from the catalog default utility-account family to the trash-specific waste-hauler family. Researched from the public crrwasteservices.com Pay and Customer Service pages (client-rendered, read in a browser) and the public CR&R Online Bill Pay (Soft-Pak Web-Pak) sign-in page and FAQ; never signed in. Sign-in is one page with E-Mail and a case-sensitive password; Register Now needs the Customer Number and Access Code from the bill and is confirmed by an e-mailed link. The real portal limits passwords to 3-10 characters, which would reject the fleet test passwords, so no passwordRule is set. The Pay page describes two ways to pay: enroll in recurring payment (charged on the 25th of each month, next business day if the 25th is a weekend; changes take effect from the next billing; a current balance must be paid separately) or a one-time payment (posts within up to two business days). The header Quick Pay link opens the same sign-in page, so guest pay is marked unsupported (inferred). Accounts 60+ days late may have service stopped; restarting after cancellation or container removal may carry a fee and payment arrangements are made with local Customer Service, so payment_arrangement is unsupported online (documented). Customer support 800-826-9677, Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; live chat Monday-Friday 8:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m. No convenience fee or late-fee amount is published (no fees set). Many CR&R cities bill trash on the city utility or property-tax bill instead. The recurring-payment draft day is modelled with billing.autopay.days [25]; the waste-hauler template has no day picker, so its page uses the generic draft-date wording (cross-owner request: fixed day-of-month AutoPay wording).

registration.note: Register with the customer number and access code from the front of your bill and a current e-mail address, then confirm through the e-mailed link.

pay_online.note: One-time online payments can take up to two business days to post to your account.

guest_pay.note: CR&R online payments are made after signing in to Online Bill Pay. Register with the customer number and access code from your bill, or call Customer Support at 800-826-9677.

autopay.note: Recurring payments are charged on the 25th of each month (the next business day if the 25th falls on a weekend). Enrolling or making changes takes effect with your next billing, so pay any current balance separately.

autopay_cancel.note: Recurring payments are managed from Billing Options (Modify); changes take effect with your next billing.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment arrangements are made with CR&R Customer Service, not online. Call 800-826-9677, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cancel_service.note: Service changes and stops are handled by CR&R Customer Service, not Online Bill Pay. Call 800-826-9677, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

help.title: Two ways to pay your CR&R bill
paragraphs: Recurring payment: enroll once and your card or bank account is charged automatically on the 25th of each month, or the next business day when the 25th falls on a weekend. Enrollment and changes start with your next billing, so if you have a balance now, also make a one-time payment.
One-time payment: sign in to Online Bill Pay and enter your card or bank account each time you pay. Online payments can take up to two business days to reach your account.
To get started you need the customer number and the access code from the front of your waste and recycling bill, plus a current e-mail address.

help.title: If your account is past due
paragraphs: Service may be stopped on accounts that are 60 days or more late. After you pay, allow up to three business days for service to resume before your next pickup.

If service was canceled or your containers were removed, a fee may apply to restart. Contact your local CR&R Customer Service to make payment arrangements and restart service: 800-826-9677, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

help.title: How to register for Online Bill Pay
paragraphs: On the CR&R Online Bill Pay Sign In page, find the Are you a new user? section and choose Register Now. Enter the Customer Number and the Access Code printed on your statement or invoice, your e-mail address and a password, then select Register Now.

An e-mail with a confirmation link is sent to the address you entered. Open the link and sign in to finish. Your e-mail address is your username; you can change it later under User Options, Change Username.

help.title: How to enroll in automatic payments
paragraphs: Automatic payments pay each invoice from a saved card or bank account. You agree to the Terms and Conditions when you pick the payment method.
steps: Sign in and select Autopay Enrollment.
Pick a saved payment method, or choose Add New and enter one.
Check I agree to the Terms and Conditions.
Choose Select (or Add Payment) to finish enrolling.

help.title: How to change automatic payments
paragraphs: Select Autopay Enrollment to open Billing Options, then choose Modify in the Automatic Payments section. Add a new payment method or pick another saved one, agree to the Terms and Conditions and choose Select.

help.title: How to change your bill delivery options
paragraphs: After signing in, select Billing Options. The button only appears when your online login is the admin for that account number.

Three On/Off switches control delivery: E-Mail Notifications Only (an e-mail when the bill is ready to view online), E-Mail Notifications With Bill Attached (the bill as a PDF), and Printed Bill (a paper bill by mail). Choose Submit to save. The same window holds the primary billing e-mail address.

extra.intent: Using CR&R's help pages, find on which day of the month CR&R charges recurring (automatic) payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Recurring payments are charged on the 25th of each month (next business day if it falls on a weekend).
